learning_outcomes.text: Master the basic principles of the function of commonly used transport devices and means and handling techniques.
Get to know the basics of their construction and technological calculations.
Familiarization with transported materials, their classification, properties and storage.

syllabus_topics: Classification of transported materials. Mechanical properties of particulate materials.
Classification of transport. Calculation of carrying capacity.
Equation of motion.
Methods of transfer of tensile forces.
Analyses of tension forces in endless tensile element - graphical - numerical method.
Tensile elements - ropes, chains and conveyor belts. Construction.
Construction and calculation of particulate material silos.
Silo closures and feeders.
Belt conveyor, principle, division and main parts.
Technological equipment of belt conveyor.

Theory and basic calculation of belt conveyor. Standard 
RČSN ISO 5048.
Bucket conveyor - construction, main parts, calculation.
Apron conveyor - construction, basics of chain conveyor calculation.
Scraper conveyor - construction, basics of chain conveyor calculation.
En-Masse conveyor - construction, basics of chain conveyor calculation.
Vibratory conveyor - scheme, possibilities of excitation of vibrations, calculation of basic parameters of vibrating conveyor.
Screw conveyor - construction, division, simplified calculation of screw conveyor parameters.
Transport by gravity - chutes, troughs and gravity roller conveyors.
Driven roller conveyors - construction, methods of drive, basic calculation - resistance to movement.
Lifts - division, construction and main parts, calculation of safety coefficient of ropes and checking of frictional abilities.
